Basecamp is used in over 100 countries, on every populated continent, across every industry imaginable.

highlights: camp’s current size (about 50 people in the whole company, roughly a dozen in the product team) we’ve been able to specialize roles so teams of designers and programmers can work without any interruption in the cycles. request.query: basecamp.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website basecamp.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: basecamp.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
basecamp.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
basecamp.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count

properties.name: BaseCamp | Agência de Comunicação | Portugal
properties.description:
Queremos ajudar cada empresa a comunicar com uma imagem da qual se orgulha.
Desde o logotipo, web design, folheto, fotografia até à atualização das suas lojas on-line! Temos clientes orgulhosos em Ourém, Fátima, Leiria, Marinha Grande, Torres Novas, Coimbra, ...
Num tempo em que a tecnologia e a imagem valem tudo, um segundo de atraso, faz com que a sua empresa perca um lugar ao sol. 
É preciso pensar diferente para chegar mais longe, ver o que ninguém vê e acreditar no que parece impossível...
A BASECAMP oferece uma abordagem pessoal, estabelecendo um constante diálogo para que as reais necessidades do seu projeto sejam satisfeitas.
Desde um simples folheto promocional a uma complexa criação de uma identidade visual ou sinalética, oferecemos-lhe sempre soluções que comunicam os valores do seu negócio e os objetivos que pretende alcançar.

headquarters.address: Avenida Dom Nuno Álvares Pereira, Edifício Monumental, nº222 2º pt4, Vila Nova de Ourém, Santarém 2490-485, PT
